full_judgment: 3. The plaintiff filed this suit stating inter alia that C. S. plot No. 44 was held by one Sailandra Nath Mukherjee and plot no. 43 was held by one Sukesh Chandra Roy. The plaintiff and the defendant jointly auction purchased Sukesh Chandra Roy's interest along with other lands in rent sale held on 7th August, 1940 in Execution Case No. 41 of 1941 of the learned Munsif of the second court, Jhenidah. The sale having been confirmed on 13th August, 1947, the parties took delivery of possession on the 27th November, 1947 and began to possess the same. There was an amicable settlement between the parties about 15 or 16 years back in consequence of which the plaintiff got the land of Kadirpur mouza out of the auction purchased land and possesses the same. Subsequently the plaintiff auction purchased plot No. 44 on the 5th December, 1955 in Rent Execution Case No. 1075 of 1955, of the 2nd Court of Munsif, jhenidah, and possessed the land in khas after taking due delivery of possession. Half of the share of the said land having been wrongly recorded in the name of defendant the title of the plaintiff was clouded.
